package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func (runtime *Runtime) Cancel(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID, idempotencyKey, reason string) (domain.TaskInstance, int, error) {
	studentID, instanceID, idempotencyKey, reason = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(instanceID), strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey), strings.TrimSpace(reason)
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(idempotencyKey) || reason != "student_cancelled" {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, 0, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	commandDigest, err := domain.CommandDigest(struct {
		StudentID, TaskInstanceID, Reason string
	}{studentID, instanceID, reason})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, 0, err
	}
	unlock := runtime.lockInstance(instanceID)
	defer unlock()
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCancelled {
		return instance.PublicProjection(), 200, nil
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceStarting && instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID != "" {
		lock, lockErr := runtime.Workspace.LockWrites(ctx, ports.LockWorkspaceWrites{SandboxID: instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID,
			RequestID: idempotencyKey, Mode: "PERMANENT"})
		if lockErr != nil || lock.LockID == "" || !lock.Permanent {
			return domain.TaskInstance{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
		}
	}
	if instance.Provisioning.StudentReserved && instance.LearningActionID != "" {
		binding, cancelErr := runtime.Student.CancelProvisioning(ctx, ports.CancelLearningAction{StudentID: instance.StudentID,
			TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, LearningActionID: instance.LearningActionID, Reason: reason})
		if cancelErr != nil || !validCancelledLearningAction(binding, instance) {
			return domain.TaskInstance{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
		}
	}
	instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceCancelled
	instance.UpdatedAt = runtime.now()
	instance, err = runtime.Repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if _, err := runtime.Repository.CreateOrLoadCommandReceipt(ctx, idempotencyKey, instance.ID, "cancel", commandDigest); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	return instance.PublicProjection(), 200, nil
}

func validCancelledLearningAction(binding ports.LearningActionBinding, instance domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	return domain.IsCanonicalUUID(binding.LearningActionID) && binding.LearningActionID == instance.LearningActionID &&
		binding.StudentID == instance.StudentID && binding.TaskInstanceID == instance.ID && binding.TaskRevisionID == instance.TaskRevisionID &&
		binding.TaskRevisionDigest == instance.TaskRevisionDigest && binding.SurfaceClassification == instance.SurfaceClassification &&
		binding.LifecycleStatus == "CANCELLED" && sameTargets(binding.LearningTargets, uniqueTargets(instance.Steps))
}

func (runtime *Runtime) Review(ctx context.Context, instanceID, submissionID, reviewerID, decision, feedback string) (domain.Submission, int, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(submissionID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(reviewerID) ||
		(decision != "APPROVE" && decision != "CHANGES_REQUESTED") || !validReviewFeedback(feedback) {
		return domain.Submission{}, 0, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	feedback = strings.TrimSpace(feedback)
	unlock := runtime.lockInstance(instanceID)
	defer unlock()
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstanceByID(ctx, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	submission, err := runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, instanceID, submissionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if submission.HumanReview != nil {
		if submission.HumanReview.ReviewerID == reviewerID && submission.HumanReview.Decision == decision && submission.HumanReview.Feedback == feedback {
			if decision == "APPROVE" && instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInReview {
				return runtime.completeApprovedReview(ctx, instance, submission)
			}
			return submission.PublicProjection(), 200, nil
		}
		return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInReview || instance.FinalSubmissionID != submission.ID || submission.Scope != "FINAL" || submission.Status != domain.SubmissionReviewRequired {
		return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	now := runtime.now()
	receipt := &domain.HumanReviewReceipt{ReviewerID: reviewerID, Decision: decision, Feedback: feedback, ReviewedAt: now}
	submission.HumanReview = receipt
	submission.UpdatedAt = now
	instance.UpdatedAt = now
	if decision == "CHANGES_REQUESTED" {
		if err := runtime.unlockSubmission(ctx, submission, deterministicUUID(submission.ID, "review-changes-requested")); err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, 503, err
		}
		submission.Status = domain.SubmissionChangesRequested
		instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
		if err := runtime.Repository.SaveReview(ctx, submission, instance, reviewerID, decision); err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
		}
		return submission.PublicProjection(), 200, nil
	}
	return runtime.completeApprovedReview(ctx, instance, submission)
}

func (runtime *Runtime) completeApprovedReview(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission) (domain.Submission, int, error) {
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInReview || submission.Status != domain.SubmissionReviewRequired || submission.HumanReview == nil || submission.HumanReview.Decision != "APPROVE" {
		return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	now := runtime.now()
	permanentLock, err := runtime.Workspace.LockWrites(ctx, ports.LockWorkspaceWrites{SandboxID: instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID,
		RequestID: deterministicUUID(submission.ID, "review-approved"), Mode: "PERMANENT", SubmissionID: submission.ID})
	if err != nil || permanentLock.LockID == "" || !permanentLock.Permanent {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	submission.Status = domain.SubmissionPassed
	instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceCompleted
	instance.FinalSubmissionID = submission.ID
	instance.CompletedAt = &now
	instance.UpdatedAt = now
	payload, err := passedEvidencePayload(instance, submission, now)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if err := runtime.Repository.CompleteInstanceAndEnqueueEvidence(ctx, instance, submission, payload); err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	return submission.PublicProjection(), 200, nil
}

func validReviewFeedback(value string) bool {
	if len(value) > 4000 {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value {
		if character < 0x20 && character != '\n' && character != '\r' && character != '\t' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func deterministicUUID(namespace, name string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(namespace + "\x00" + name))
	value := append([]byte(nil), sum[:16]...)
	value[6] = value[6]&0x0f | 0x50
	value[8] = value[8]&0x3f | 0x80
	hexValue := hex.EncodeToString(value)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s-%s-%s", hexValue[:8], hexValue[8:12], hexValue[12:16], hexValue[16:20], hexValue[20:])
}
